summary: A WordPress (Lay theme) specimen built as a stack of full-screen slides on warm grey: each 100vh slide holds one centred SVG specimen of the seal-like 'japonism' ligature font, with a small bold caption bottom-left. It walks through the idea, the Inkan-seal origin, the ligature system, the character set by category, borders, styles × weights and a lookbook of posters, then ends on 'Visit the shop'. All type is shown as images; nothing moves or can be typed.

instances.look: One red seal-shaped ligature (the name written as a single stamp) centred on warm grey, with 'NIHON TYPEFACE' in bold caps and a two-line tagline below
instances.feel: Calm, formal, like a stamped document
instances.ux: Static; a slim nav (name left, Shop / License / About / Imprint right) slides away on scroll down
instances.learn: When the font turns a whole word into one glyph, the logo can be the font's own ligature for the name, set as a stamp

reconstruction.layout: Full-screen 1440×900 slide; seal ~185×250px centred at y≈250–500; title centred at y≈590; tagline two lines centred below; site nav row at the very top (name x≈30, links right-aligned)
reconstruction.typography: Seal: SVG of the Nihon 'Border' style ligature in solid red; title ~32px Helvetica Bold uppercase; tagline ~24px Helvetica Regular, centred, leading ~1.3; nav ~16px Helvetica
reconstruction.behaviour: none; nav translates up out of view while scrolling down
reconstruction.content: 'NIHON TYPEFACE — An ornamental japonism typefamily with 24 fonts and more than 30.000 ligatures.'

Three words set as vertical ligature stacks side by side (black 'MOONY', red 'OUTTHINK', black 'NIKO'), each with its Latin spelling in tiny tracked caps running down beside it

instances.look: Full-screen slides, each one centred diagram and a bold caption bottom-left: 'WHAT IS NIHON?' (the word LATIN in plain vertical caps → black Nihon → red Nihon), 'LIGATURE SYSTEM' (red ligatures above the black letters they are built from, labelled KI / NOU / SHE), 'BORDER ADAPTABILITY' (the same word in red framed seals and a hairline box of a different length)
instances.feel: Patient, gallery-like, one idea per screen
instances.ux: Static; scrolling steps one slide at a time
instances.learn: Give each design mechanism its own full screen: one input → output diagram and one caption, so an unusual ligature system is learned step by step

reconstruction.layout: Each slide 1440×900; diagram centred in columns 4–10 of a 12-column grid (~560–800px wide), vertically centred slightly high; caption block bottom-left at x≈30, max ~900px wide: heading, then up to 4 lines of prose

reconstruction.content: Real explanation: 'builds the bridge between the western and eastern typography… write and read in latin letters with an japanese appearance'; 'each letter will adjust its look depending on the next letter following… more than 1200 ligatures for each font'

instances.look: A small red rounded Inkan-style seal in the centre of the grey screen and 'WHERE DOES IT COME FROM?' with four lines of prose bottom-left
instances.learn: One emblem of the source (a seal) plus a four-line caption is enough origin story for a display face

instances.learn: Run each category as a vertical column (upper, lower, ligatures) side by side so a tall, narrow script-like font reads like a column of seals
